messages:
kai: Heads-up: p99 on /v1/generate in eu-west spiked to ~1.2s about 10m ago after we applied the weighted routing tweak. p50/p95 look fine. anyone else seeing this?

lina: seeing it in the dashboard too. sample count for that endpoint dropped ~40% at same time. :thinking: 

ravi: routing change moved ~30% traffic to dedicated-v2 backend. Dedicated has different telemetry tags; could be a merge/rollup issue.

marta: Are we rolling up across backends before percentile calc? If so tdigest merge might be biased when sample distributions differ.

kai: we currently rollup tdigest blobs per minute by endpoint+region then compute percentiles. We lost per-backend sample counts in the tag merge step.

lina: uhoh. That would make p99 unreliable when one backend has much fewer samples but much higher latency.

ravi: quick check from metrics:
```
SELECT approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99)
FROM rollups
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='eu-west' AND ts > now() - interval '15 minutes';
```
This returns ~1180ms. But a count() by backend shows dedicated-v2 had only ~120 samples vs hosted ~1200.

marta: Can we change rollup key to keep backend tag until percentiles computed? Or store total_count in the tdigest meta so merges are weighted correctly. Either would let us avoid bias.

kai: patch idea: include 'n' (sample_count) in rollup proto so merging uses weighted tdigest merge. Also add dashboard column 'sample_count' next to percentiles and a 'show-by-backend' drilldown. UX: default hide low-sample percentiles.

ops-bot: deployed rollout-config 2026-03-20T15:02: applied routing weights for eu-west (canary=0.3).

lina: for short-term: add annotation on dashboard when sample_count < 500: 'percentiles may be unstable'. Can we add that quick?

ravi: happy to make a small backend change to attach sample_count to the rollup blobs. I'll open a PR and add tests for weighted merge. @marta can you help with the dashboard change?

marta: on it, will add a conditional tooltip + extra column. Also propose a 'raw-samples' toggle that fetches underlying samples for debugging so we can compute percentiles client-side for validation.

kai: :thumbsup: Thanks team — let's track this in a tiny RFC so data-hiccups from routing don't trigger false SLO alerts. filing one now.
